archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) - Modified for Calm Enterprise SaaS
design_philosophy: A clean, modern, and highly readable interface emphasizing calm focus. Designed for enterprise, healthcare, and education to reduce meeting anxiety. Uses soft earthy tones rather than harsh corporate blues or clinical whites. Adheres to strict optical alignment and logical hierarchy.

typography.guidelines: Never use Inter for headings. Keep letter-spacing tight for headings and loose for body. Use varied weights (font-light for massive heroes, font-bold for tiny overlines).

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use Tailwind scale with generous multiplier (e.g., p-6, p-8, p-12).

dashboard_grid.rules: Dense, exact alignment. h-full on children to prevent jagged bottoms.

pre_join_grid.spans: Video Preview: col-span-12 md:col-span-8. Settings Panel: col-span-12 md:col-span-4.

live_meeting_grid.classes: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-4 p-4
live_meeting_grid.rules: Must fill viewport height minus header/control bar. Use object-cover for video elements.

cards.rules: Internal padding must be p-6 or p-8. No soft muddy shadows, just crisp 1px borders with shadow-sm.

glass_panels.classes: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border border-white/40 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] rounded-2xl
glass_panels.rules: Used for floating control bars, sticky headers, and pre-join overlays.

inputs_and_forms.classes: bg-transparent border-b-2 border-[#E2E4E0] focus:border-[#4A5D4E] rounded-none px-0 py-2 focus:ring-0 focus:outline-none transition-colors
inputs_and_forms.rules: Avoid default boxed inputs where possible; use clean underlined inputs for settings to fit the minimalist aesthetic.

buttons.primary: bg-[#4A5D4E] text-white rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 font-medium hover:bg-[#3E4E42] transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-[#E8EAE6] text-[#1F2937] rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 font-medium hover:bg-[#DCE0D9] transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.destructive: bg-[#C87967] text-white rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 font-medium hover:bg-[#B56555] transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.icon_button: p-3 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center transition-all bg-[#E8EAE6] hover:bg-[#DCE0D9] text-[#1F2937]

meeting_controls.container: fixed bottom-8 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border border-white/40 rounded-full px-6 py-3 shadow-lg flex items-center gap-4

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: ALWAYS set explicit text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-[#3E4E42] hover:text-white). Buttons should have active:scale-95.
interactions_and_motion.focus_states: High contrast ring: focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#4A5D4E] focus-visible:ring-offset-2.
interactions_and_motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition: transform 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease. No transition-all for complex layouts.
interactions_and_motion.page_load: Fade in with a slight upward drift (y: 10px -> 0px) for main dashboard sections.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: CRITICAL: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid. Format: data-testid='[action]-[element]'. Examples: data-testid='join-meeting-button', data-testid='toggle-mic-icon-button'.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure APCA compliant text contrast. Muted text should not fall below 4.5:1 ratio against background.

backgrounds.description: Abstract soft pink and white gradient background

instructions_to_main_agent: Multilingual Support: Ensure all UI strings are abstracted into a localization framework or structured to support switching between English and German seamlessly.
Dashboard Setup: Implement the Dashboard utilizing Shadcn UI components but override border radiuses to 'rounded-xl' and borders to 'border-[#E2E4E0]'. No muddy shadows.
Pre-Join Layout: Divide screen 8-columns for video/placeholder and 4-columns for settings. Include inputs for display name and toggles for device testing.
Live Meeting View: The video grid must auto-adjust based on participant count (CSS Grid auto-fit/auto-fill). The control bar must hover at the bottom (fixed, z-50).
Testing: Add data-testid to every single button, form input, and interactive panel without exception.
Icons: Use lucide-react throughout. Maintain consistent 20px size and 2px stroke width unless in hero sections.
Never use generic Bootstrap columns. Emphasize asymmetry and tension in marketing pages if any, but maintain strict control room precision in the app dashboard.
